title: Truncate without breaking characters
hints: Slicing a string, s[:n], cuts at a byte offset, which can land in the middle of a multi-byte character and leave invalid UTF-8.
Count and cut in runes: convert to []rune, or range over s, where the index of the k-th rune is its byte offset. If s has at most max runes, return it unchanged.
r := []rune(s); if len(r) <= max { return s }; if max <= 0 { return "" }; return string(r[:max-1]) + "…"
